source: O*NET 30.3 Database, U.S. Department of Labor / Employment and Training Administration, used under CC BY 4.0. Modified: process steps consolidated into the terms practitioners use, and filtered to work software can assist.
note: Generated by pipeline/onet_tasks.py --build from data/onet/mapping.json. Do not hand edit and do not mirror these slugs in Python or JS — the 15 domain categories are duplicated in six places and that is the mistake this avoids. `occupations` is evidence (who performs this step, per O*NET); `label`/`term` are our naming, falsified against practitioner text with --validate.
